column1: # DGCA Tariff Monitoring Unit — average airfare on monitored routes.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AND IS MOSTLY EMPTY
# The PS asks for ">= 30 days of back-tested results against publicly available DGCA
# monthly average-fare data". DGCA's Tariff Monitoring Unit does publish such figures
# but only through monthly reports
column2: press notes and Parliament replies as PDFs/tabled

column1: # answers. There is no API and no CSV. So this file is the seam: a human extracts the
# published table once a month
column2: records it here WITH ITS CITATION

column1: # picks it up with no code change.
# RULES
#   * provenance=PUBLISHED         -> a real figure from a real DGCA/PIB publication.
#                                     Only these are used as a validation benchmark.
#   * provenance=ANALYST_CALIBRATION -> anything else. NEVER used as a benchmark;
#                                     available to the reconstruction model only
#                                     labelled as such wherever it surfaces.
#   * source_citation is mandatory and must identify the document
# If this file contains no PUBLISHED rows
# "dgca_tmu_route_average_fare: benchmark not loaded" and validates against
# CPI item 294 instead — which is a real
# in fact the series APIx exists to augment. Add rows here to widen the validation;
# do not add rows you cannot cite.
